capabilities: : Edit wireframes using a live preview editor
: Insert components from a snippet palette
extras: Desktop-only for now; not tested on mobile.
intentEvidence: Write a few lines of text and get a hand-drawn screen made of native Excalidraw elements
problem: Manually creating Balsamiq-style wireframes is time-consuming and requires drawing skills.

relations.evidence: Built on Excalidraw and the Obsidian Excalidraw plugin by Zsolt Viczián.
Syntax ideas from Wireframy (MIT), which also has an Obsidian plugin that renders wireframes in notes.

summary: Sketchdown generates Balsamiq-style wireframes within Excalidraw by converting short text specifications into native, editable Excalidraw elements.
